notes.title: Input / controls update and playtests
notes.content:
[p]We spent the last two weeks completely reworking our [b]input system[/b]. This was something we pinpointed after analyzing your feedback from the [b]demo survey[/b] - for which we're super grateful!

The input system now works with both [b]mouse/keyboard[/b] and [b]gamepad[/b] devices (which also means SteamDeck compatibility). We implemented a [b]virtual mouse[/b] for gamepads, along with many quality-of-life features like arrow/WSAD camera movement, edge scrolling, and many others.[/p][p][/p][p]All these changes are now available to test via [b]Steam Playtest[/b].[/p][p]Any feedback is much appreciated! 💛[/p]
